resource_alternative.trigger: Auditable output truncation or session/global resource refusal on the baseline; do not trigger just for unresolved outcomes
resource_alternative.other_settings: Keep baseline settings; if a different cap is causally binding, prerecord targeted numerical change and rationale before rerunning all three designated cases
resource_alternative.selection: Prefer original setting unless measured usable-flow coverage improves; do not select using test or official solved outcomes

prefix_selection_order: exclude settings unable to complete prefix or preserve minimum continuation on still-running cases
maximize valid-flow coverage: public-pass shared stop or valid complete paired execution
repeat_rule: Reuse the actual .30 screen only if exact execution/config/image identity is unchanged; otherwise use a new run. Full dev23 has a new population/config identity and is not merged with screen records.
duplicate_rule_design: Keep n=2 for baseline; thresholds >=.5 explicitly represent a disabled duplicate signal under strict >. Preserve warnings. No post-test redesign.

budget.retry_policy: zero model retries; interruptions reconciled first
budget.allocation: Review actual screen spend before each next setting and reserve the remainder for full dev and test; no automatic increase beyond100

model_identity: Must use actual observed alias and record fingerprint/created; immutable snapshot is not fabricated
